content:
Headquarters: Düsseldorf





What you’ll do:






  • Keep CI/CD pipelines running across multiple repositories and teams.
  • Improve and standardize pipelines: reusable templates, consistent steps, fewer surprises.
  • Maintain and improve developer tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, and SonarQube (or comparable tools).
  • Add practical checks to pipelines: tests, code quality gates, and basic security scanning.
  • Help developers when pipelines fail: find the cause, fix it, and prevent repeats.
  • Support moving and aligning repositories, pipelines, and tooling across teams.
  • Write clear documentation so teams can help themselves.
  • Grow step by step into more advanced topics like IaC, platform tooling, and cloud automation.









What you should already know (basics are enough))






  • First hands-on experience with CI/CD (Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins—any is fine).
  • You can automate small tasks with scripts (Bash, PowerShell, or Python).
  • You understand Git workflows (branches, pull requests, reviews).
  • You’ve touched build/test automation in at least one ecosystem (e.g., .NET, C++, Delphi, Java, Node.js).
  • You’ve seen code quality tooling (SonarQube or similar).
  • You have a basic grasp of cloud/infrastructure concepts (what environments are, what deployment means, why permissions matter).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with Azure DevOps organizations/pipelines/boards.
  • Any exposure to GitHub Enterprise administration or repo management.
  • Docker basics.
  • Interest in AWS or cloud platforms.

 




To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/charisma-tec-junior-devops-engineer-ci-cd-developer-tooling-remote-m-f-d
